script.name: Copy the Steam client libraries next to the server
script.description: Copy the Steam client libraries next to the server
script.code:
rem The server loads the Steam client libraries from its own folder; the depot ships them at the root.
for %%F in (steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll) do if exist "%%F" copy /Y "%%F" "WS\Binaries\Win64\" >nul
